reviewMethod: Viewed all nine complete raw images and the approved model preview; keyed sheets are auxiliary material previews only.
suggestionScope: Material directions only, not structural acceptance or permission to promote these raw images to 48-step refinement.
commonIssues: The authored front-left flag moved to the far screen-left side. Component placement is not preserved closely enough for structural acceptance.
Compass emblems are brighter and some stone, brick and roof patterns are denser than the restrained v5 material target.
Map-table colors are too vivid in several candidates; reduce saturation while keeping their functional identity.
Generated background shadows or green gradients are not game grounding assets. Do not import them or reuse mismatched Depth as an alpha mask.

candidates.positive: Clear timber, olive canvas and fieldstone materials.
candidates.issues: Roof-end shape, closed entrance and flag placement drift from the approved model; extra table framing.

candidates.positive: Preferred LV1 material direction; continuous canvas roof reads clearly.
candidates.issues: Flag placement and entrance differ from the model; added rocks at the wall base and oversized steps.

candidates.positive: Canvas seams and wooden frame are legible.
candidates.issues: Invented device or statue on the planning table, plus flag and entrance drift; do not promote.

candidates.positive: Two-storey brick and slate identity is clear.
candidates.issues: Telegraph crossbar became a busy multi-arm aerial; roof and flag placement drift; dense fine texture.

candidates.positive: Preferred LV2 material direction; orderly brick, stone trim and blue-grey slate, with flat entrance canopy.
candidates.issues: Aerial shape, roof end, window proportions and flag placement differ from the approved model; bright emblem.

candidates.positive: Brick and slate remain within the same building family.
candidates.issues: Added a second roof aerial and changed the flat entrance canopy into a pitched roof; do not promote.

candidates.positive: Concrete and blue-grey glazing establish the modern tier.
candidates.issues: Added a second flag with an unrequested emblem; altered facade glazing and flag placement; do not promote.

candidates.positive: Preferred LV3 material direction; restrained concrete and steel, one dish and one flag.
candidates.issues: Flag placement, central facade proportions and model emblem count differ; roof equipment detail expanded and map too saturated.

candidates.positive: Concrete, steel and glazing are distinct from the lower tiers.
candidates.issues: Added a second equipment box and extra roof aerials; flag placement drift; pronounced backdrop shadow. Preview threshold 128 damaged the facade, so only the preview was regenerated at 80.

nextStage: Choose a material direction if desired; revise the authored model/control representation as needed and rerun 12-step structural candidates. Only a structurally passing, user-selected raw may enter 48-step refinement.
